description: 부산광역시_자전거 도로정보 서비스 [roads, bridges and tunnels and cycling networks] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 부산광역시. 부산광역시의 자전거 도로정보(구군명, 시작지점, 종료지점, 구간길이 등)를 담고 있는 데이터입니다. Coverage: 부산광역시. The portal files it under the publisher 부산광역시. Its tags are 자전거, 자전거도로, 자전거보관대, 건강, 자전거전용. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-07-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
